site_name: Equinix NY4, 755 Secaucus Rd, Secaucus, NJ 07094
year_evidence_quote: today announced the grand opening of its fourth Internet Business Exchange™ (IBX®) center in the New York area (NY4).
year_site_match: The Equinix release is datelined Secaucus, NJ, names the facility NY4, and says "The first phase of the $95 million NY4 center, located in Secaucus, NJ". No page I opened prints the street address 755 Secaucus Rd; the tie of that address to NY4 rests on the dataset's site label (directory-derived). Equinix's own NY4 page returned HTTP 403 and was treated as unavailable. PeeringDB (opened via its public API) lists a single combined record "Equinix NY2/NY4/NY5/NY6 - New York, Secaucus" at 800 Secaucus Road, so it confirms NY4 is in the Secaucus campus but does not confirm the 755 address.
verification: Opening year 2007 for NY4 is supported by three opened pages: the Equinix press release dated Nov 7, 2007 (grand opening), Data Center Knowledge bylined Nov 7, 2007 ("which opens today"), and Data Center Knowledge bylined May 5, 2009 ("The $95 million first phase of the center was opened in November 2007."). Caveat, flagged explicitly: the link between NY4 and the street address 755 Secaucus Rd was NOT verified on any page I opened (Equinix's NY4 page refused automated access). It is my unverified background understanding, not a sourced fact, that NY4 is at 755 Secaucus Road and NY5 at 800 Secaucus Road. If the pipeline requires a primary-page address tie, downgrade this to not_verified; the year for the named facility NY4 itself is solid. Note also that Equinix NY2 (a separate, older Secaucus building) is grouped with NY4 in PeeringDB's campus record; this result dates NY4 only, not NY2.
